description: After a download was refused with a connect link and code (download_limit without a key) and the user says they connected: returns api_key once they pressed Connect, made on their free account. Call it once after their reply, not in a loop: while status is pending, show them the link and code again and end your turn. Save the key as SFXMINT_API_KEY in the project's .env (gitignored), never in source, and retry the download with Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.
name: check_connect
